summary: James McGrogan, 39, of Chesterton, IN — separated from his party at ~10 a.m. Friday on a hut trip to Eiseman Hut (Holy Cross Wilderness, north of Vail); reported missing ~5:30 p.m.; multi-team search (VMRG + RMRG + Alpine + Larimer County SAR + SCRG + Grand County SAR + Guard HAATS helicopters) searched ~18 sq mi Fri-Mon with no success; search suspended, then body recovered ~April 3 after it was found by skiers
location: Eiseman Hut area, Holy Cross Wilderness, north of Vail
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Colorado Army National Guard HAATS, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Alpine Rescue Team, Larimer County Search and Rescue, Summit County Rescue Group, Grand County Search and Rescue
notes: Alpine Rescue Team 2014 annual mission summary PDF (one-line mission log; page date used as mission date). subject count not stated in the log; recorded as 1 MERGE run 132: Alpine one-liner (mission 14-12, dated 2014-03-15 in the PDF) = the McGrogan search assist; Real Vail (opened) pins the missing report to Friday 2014-03-14 — date corrected from 2014-03-15. ECSO shifted to a recovery mission per the March 19, 2014 statement; body found ~April 3, 2014 (about 20 days later) off-route at the base of a frozen waterfall, boots missing; death ruled accidental. Over 50 rescuers + 2 Guard helicopters Fri-Mon; 700+ search hours. [run 550 merge: Vail Daily body-found follow-up URL (opened this run) added; corroborates the Apr 3, 2014 recovery after the five-day 110-rescuer search.]
